title: An unpin with no moderator name skips the scheduled-post displacement check silently
current: For an 'unsticky' mod action on an app post, the displacement check is recorded only when event.moderator.name is present and isn't the app. Without a moderator name, the handler returns with no log, so the goal may not be re-pinned after a scheduled post displaces it.
evidence: `const moderator = event.moderator?.name?.trim().toLowerCase(); if (moderator && ...)` then `return;`. The scheduled_post_displacement_unpin_received log at the top records hasActionedAt but not whether a moderator was present.
assumptions: That Reddit sends unsticky events without a moderator for some displacement cases (scheduled posts, admin or system actions).
investigate: Check the Devvit ModAction trigger payload docs and the installed types: is moderator optional, and when?
Search r/SubGoal logs for scheduled_post_displacement_unpin_received events and compare them with recorded displacement checks.

criticality.why: A goal could lose its highlight to a scheduled post and never be restored, with nothing logged.
